expect: BEFORE offers the MCP access switch on Settings > API, no MCP settings tab and all 23 tools. AFTER offers a dedicated MCP tab with 23 rendered DOM tool rows; disabling chat there changes the actual backend tools/list to 22 tools and refuses chat calls immediately.

definitions.rendered_tool_rows: Count of [data-mcp-tool] elements in the rendered settings panel, including rows outside the scroll viewport. It is not the number simultaneously visible.
definitions.advertised_tools: Count of tool objects returned by tools/list from the same base URL photographed, authenticated with an actual API key.
definitions.chat_off: The chat row switch has aria-checked=false, GET /api/settings/mcp-access reports chat enabled=false, tools/list excludes chat, and tools/call chat returns tool_disabled.

layout: Capture same dialog-sized crop on both sides. Preserve original pixels, pad without scaling and vertically stack with readable labels. Also retain the after overview before scrolling to chat.
adapter_note: The reviewed repo has no scripts/pr_ui_scenes registry/common implementation; this is a task-local explicit adapter, not an invocation of an absent upstream scene framework.
